data.content_ref: inline:SRC_011's committed-root checkpoint contradicts SRC_013's preservation of root validity: the checkpoint suspends any root whose only defenders are UNDEC, yet in the two-pass semantics a root can be outer-accepted precisely because its defenders were accepted through the warrant-filtered outer graph while remaining UNDEC in the inner pass, so the checkpoint re-imports the self-referential blindness SRC_013 names as its weakness. Refuted if no case exists where a root is outer-accepted while all its defenders are inner-UNDEC.
